newsitem.title: TURKEY: Fifty-five die Turkish road crashes in one day.
newsitem.headline: Fifty-five die Turkish road crashes in one day.

text.p: A total of 55 people were killed and 66 injured in traffic accidents throughout Turkey in 24 hours, state-run Anatolian news agency said on Friday.
Twenty-eight of the dead were killed when a coach crashed into a ditch in the east of the country on Friday, local officials said.
"We believe the bus crashed into the ditch because the driver fell asleep at the wheel," Recep Yazicioglu, governor of eastern Erzincan province, told Reuters.
He said the crash happened at about 5 a.m. (0200 GMT) at Sakaltutan, 20 km (12 miles) west of the town of Erzincan.
Anatolian said 16 people were injured in the accident as the double-decker coach travelled from Ankara to Agri in eastern Turkey. It said three people died in hospital.
It said the 55 were killed and 66 injured in crashes throughout the country in the 24-hours up to 1430 GMT on Friday.
Turkey has one of the worst road traffic death rates in the world. Last Sunday, 18 people died in a motorway pile-up in southern Turkey.
